name: deterministic-kernel benchmark suite (R9)
description: Fixed benchmark: arithmetic, logic, scheduling, anti-hallucination, technical (RAG), codefix, long-reasoning. Ground truth is stated per case. Run via tests/acceptance/run_benchmark.sh against the REAL local model (no mocks).
